chunks: From him, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Whoever unsheathes a sword, then his blood is without compensation.”

key_terms.دَمُهُ: his blood, meaning his life in legal liability context
key_terms.هَدَرٌ: without compensation or protected legal claim

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a person who draws a sword against others in a hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning one who openly initiates lethal aggression by drawing a sword. It indicates the grave consequence attached to armed unlawful violence and reflects the protection of public order and the deterrence of transgression.
